title: The feedforward sweep is unconscious however deep it reaches

statements.text: Any visual operation carried out through feedforward connections, including feature extraction and categorization of shapes and faces, proceeds without consciousness. Information sweeps from visual to frontal areas without experience, and a deep enough sweep can even drive unconscious behavior.

sources.quote: any visual operation that is "hardwired" via feedforward connections does not depend on any form of consciousness
Information sweeps from visual to frontal areas, not accompanied by conscious experience
Unconscious behavioral effects (like priming) are possible only when the feedforward sweep penetrates deeply into the sensorimotor cascade.
